articles.title: FG Unveils National Digital Economy Agenda to Power Youth Jobs
articles.excerpt: A plan to expand broadband access and skill one million young people in digital trades.
articles.author: amina-yusuf
body: The Federal Government has unveiled an ambitious National Digital Economy Agenda designed to broaden broadband coverage, cut the cost of connectivity and equip one million young Nigerians with employable digital skills.
Industry analysts say the plan, if implemented with discipline, could reposition the country as a hub for software development, data centres and digital services.

articles.title: CBN Holds Rate as Inflation Eases for Third Consecutive Month
articles.excerpt: The central bank left the benchmark rate unchanged, citing cooling food prices and improved reserves.
articles.author: emeka-okafor
body: Nigeria's central bank kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged this week, signalling confidence that the disinflation trend is taking hold.
Economists are split on whetherthe next move will be a cut or another hold as the bank balances price stability against growth ambitions.

articles.title: Super Eagles Set for Crunch AFCON Qualifier in Abuja
articles.excerpt: Victory would all but seal qualificationand restore the feel-good factor around the national team.
articles.author: kemi-adewale
body: The Super Eagles trained under floodlights on Sunday evening, with the coach insistingthe focus is solely on the three points needed to edge closer to the next Africa Cup of Nations.
Kick-off is 8pm Nigerian time; Letus TV brings you live reaction from the stadium before and after the final whistle.

articles.title: Nollywood and Afrobeats Stars Unite for Mega Lagos Festival
articles.excerpt: A three-day celebration of Nigerian creativity bringing box-office directors, chart-topping actsand fashion design onto one stage.
articles.author: tunde-bello
body: Lagos is about to become the beating heart of African pop culture asthe Entertainment Festival throws open its gates on Friday.
Letus TV will be on the ground with backstage accessand interviews with the stars shapingthe soundandsight of the continent.

articles.title: New Health Campaign Targets Silent Epidemic of Hypertension
articles.excerpt: Community health workers will screen blood pressure at one million doorsand connect patients to care.
articles.author: dr-chiamaka-ude
body: Health authorities have launched a door-to-door campaign to tackle hypertension,a condition so often silent until it strikes.
Watch our documentary on the frontline health workers carrying this message into hard-to-reach communities.

articles.title: Inside Nigeria Startup Boom: Cities Building Africa Next Unicorns
articles.excerpt: From Yaba to Enugu,a new generation of founders is building global products form Lagos living roomsand co-working hubs.
articles.author: david-adeyemi
body: The loudest ideas in African technology are no longer confined to a single district.
We spoke to ten founders building everything from fintech rails to agritech marketplaces.

articles.title: Budget Debate: Lawmakers Demand Transparency on Infrastructure
articles.excerpt: A cross-party group is pushing for project-by-project reporting to endvague budget lines.
articles.author: amina-yusuf
body: A coalition of lawmakers across party lines has tabled a motion demanding project-level reportingwith timelinesand completion status.
Letus TV fact-checksthe numbersand digs into which projects have stalledand why.

articles.title: Solar Irrigation Helps Smallholder Farmers Beat the Dry Season
articles.excerpt: Farmersare trading diesel pumps for solar systemsthat cut costsand extend growing seasons.
articles.author: emeka-okafor
body: On a cassava farmin Ogun State,the hum of a solar water pump has replaced the rattle of diesel.
Farmerstell Letus TV thatthe real prize is not just yield,butpredictability of knowingthat water will come.

articles.title: Lagos Fashion Week: Designers Redefine African Luxury
articles.excerpt: Sustenable materials,bold silhouettesand a new generation of buyers are rewritingthe rules of fashion.
articles.author: tunde-bello
body: The runways of Lagos Fashion Week told a story of confidence: designers are no longer looking outward for validation.
Backstage,designers spoke about building supply chainsand protecting craft heritage while scaling.

articles.title: What Your Sleep Position Says About Your Health, Doctors Explain
articles.excerpt: On your back,side or stomach specialists breakdownethe scienceand simple fixes.
articles.author: dr-chiamaka-ude
body: The way you sleep nightly affects more than comfort,itshapes breathing,joint healthand even digestion.
We asked doctors to settle the arguments your household probably has every night.

articles.title: 5G and Beyond: What Expanding Connectivity Means for You
articles.excerpt: Faster phones are only the beginning;the next wave will change healthcare,education and farming.
articles.author: david-adeyemi
body: The rollout of faster mobile networks is reaching more cities,butthe biggest gains will be felt far beyond gamingand video calls.
This explainer breaksup what the jargonmeansand what changes you will notice first.
